column1: # pilot_label_map.tsv: the pilot's 11 attribution labels (pilots/r3/harness/analyze.py CATALOGUE) mapped onto catalogue ids (FULL_PREREG section 11).
# Written 2026-11-11 by pkg:ATTRIB_HARM; drafted_by: pkg:ATTRIB_HARM; status: prepared. Source of each
# mapping: the pilot rule text and the pilot_label column of mechanisms/catalogue.tsv. Composite pilot labels (COW|STR, STR+COW) map
# component-wise. primary_id = the single label used when a pilot label must be compared with a study primary label (family code when
# the pilot label covers several rows); a study label counts as agreeing when it is in catalogue_ids or in the family.

column6: Pilot rule: the result of a call with inplace=True is assigned (=\s*x.method(... inplace=True)). Catalogue C04 (inplace methods return self, not None, on 3.x) carries pilot_label INPLACE_RETURN.

Pilot rule: any inplace=True, chained setitem (][..]=, .loc[..][..]=), .values[ writes; 2.3.3 warnings ChainedAssignment / set on a copy / chained assignment / Copy-on-Write; option flag A1. Catalogue rows C01 (chained setitem), C02 (chained inplace), C03 (view propagation) carry pilot_label COW; the pilot label does not say which, so a pilot COW label maps to the family code QF3 (components C01, C02, C03). C05 (copy= keyword) is CoW-related but was not in the pilot rule.

Pilot rule: integer casts and unit arithmetic on dates (astype(int64), view(i8), // 10**9, .value, .asi8, datetime64[ns], to_datetime(unit=), .timestamp()) plus the [ns] -> [us|ms|s] trace signal. Catalogue D01 (parsed dates in us), D02 (numeric input unit), D03 (Period end_time resolution; pilot qwen t21__s0), D04 (date_range unit) carry pilot_label DT_UNIT; mapped to the family code QF2 when only the pilot label is known.

Pilot rule: dtype == object probes, select_dtypes(object), is_object_dtype, dtype.kind, astype(str), isinstance(..., str); option flags A2/A4. Catalogue S01 (str dtype probes), S02 (missing sentinel NaN), S03 (astype(str) keeps missing values) carry pilot_label STR_DTYPE (the pilot merged S03 into S01); for LOUD programs the same pilot label corresponds to L04 (setitem/interpolate on str). Mapped to the family code QF1.
Pilot rule: np.std/var/sum/... and the 2.3.3 warning "The provided callable"; catalogue G05 carries pilot_label NP_CALLABLE.
Pilot rule: np.<reduction>(x) and the 2.3.3 warning "axis=None is deprecated"; catalogue I01 carries pilot_label AXIS_NONE.
Pilot rule: value_counts(sort=False); catalogue R02 carries pilot_label VALUE_COUNTS_ORDER.
Pilot rule: concat( and the 2.3.3 warning "concatenation with empty or all-NA entries"; catalogue R05 carries pilot_label CONCAT_EMPTY.

Pilot rule: .apply( and the 2.3.3 warnings "apply operated on the grouping columns" / include_groups; catalogue G03 (silent: grouping columns excluded) and L06 (LOUD: KeyError on the grouping column) carry pilot_label GROUPBY_APPLY. A drift program maps to G03, a LOUD program to L06.
Pilot rule: replace/fillna/where/mask/clip/interpolate/ffill/bfill and the 2.3.3 warning "Downcasting"; catalogue N01 carries pilot_label NO_DOWNCAST.

Pilot rule: groupby/pivot_table/crosstab in a program with categorical keys and the 2.3.3 warning "observed=False is deprecated" (the default changing); that is catalogue G01. G02 (explicit observed=False with several keys) also carries pilot_label OBSERVED in the catalogue but needs the explicit keyword, which the pilot rule did not require.
